items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: Isn’t there somebody wonderful called Roy Hargrove who’s coming?

ctx.x: What do you think the future of jazz is? You know I look at the what I call world class jazz players like Clark Terry for instance, I don’t see a Clark Terry on the horizon.
Well I think there are some. Isn’t there somebody wonderful called Roy Hargrove who’s coming?
